recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-47335 unless the work group later requests a separate editorial punctuation pass.
issue_request: FHIR-47335 is an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I R6 clarification asking to stop defining Subscription as a notification and instead describe it as information about a request for notifications to a client based on a SubscriptionTopic.
initial_application: Commit be36776318c4ebe106eca9b87ed85a52d8cb7bfc applied the issue by changing source/subscription/structuredefinition-Subscription.xml from "Notification about a SubscriptionTopic" to the approved request-for-notifications wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes subscription=Subscription, placing the Subscription StructureDefinition in current build scope. FHIR-I minutes and the linked Zulip block-vote announcement show FHIR-47335 was part of the March 2025 R6 Subscription block vote approved 17-0-0. The current combined branch already contains the corrected wording, with only the terminal period omitted, which does not affect the approved meaning.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/subscription/structuredefinition-Subscription.xml already says Subscription is information about a request for notifications to a client based on a SubscriptionTopic, and a current-source search found no active occurrence of the obsolete short description.
